title: VIX futures & options November expiration (SOQ settlement) — same session as the October FOMC minutes
source: EST: THE OCC'S OWN 2027 EXPIRATION CALENDAR, fetched and decoded in-session 2026-09-08 on the same artifact this repo's opex and vix-expiration entries already use -- www.optionseducation.org/api/expirationcalendar (HTTP 200, 34,871 bytes), the Options Industry Council surface whose every page footer reads '(c) The Options Clearing Corporation. All rights reserved.' Its legend maps GUID EEF1643B-4D4D-4DCA-87AD-85A777B8ED66 to 'Monthly Volatility Products Expiration date', and its data array carries exactly that type on 2027-11-17 -- read directly, not derived by rule. The surrounding November 2027 rows read the way every month does and were checked as an assertion before the date was trusted: 2027-11-18 carries 15AA2B9D ('Monthly A.M. settled index options cease trading'), 2027-11-19 carries 6937B1D1 ('Monthly equity, index, and cash-settled currency options expiration date and PM settled index options cease trading'), 2027-11-11 is marked 'Bank holiday' and 2027-11-25 'Exchange/OCC holiday'. CORROBORATED BY THE STANDING RULE, re-derived here rather than assumed: the VIX monthly expiration is the Wednesday 30 days before the following month's third-Friday SPX expiration; the third Friday of December 2027 is 2027-12-17 and 30 days earlier is Wednesday 2027-11-17. That rule was validated against every volatility row in the same file and reproduces 32 of 36 (88.9%), the four misses being holiday-shifted months -- so the rule is corroboration only, and THIS date is the file's own statement. Filed estimate per the event-research lane's no-self-confirm limit: a proposing sweep may not promote its own discovery, and the OCC prefix belongs to the lane that researches this id. Discovered during the fomc-minutes-2027-11-17 initial research, checked 2026-09-08
notes: PROPOSED by the fomc-minutes-2027-11-17 initial research (2026-09-08), and it is the one adjacency in that lane's corridor that changes how its own event should be measured. THE COLLISION IS EXACT: the VIX monthly settlement and the FOMC minutes release land on the SAME SESSION, 2027-11-17 -- the SOQ prints at the open, the minutes at 14:00 ET, different halves of one day. WHY THAT MATTERS BEYOND THIS DATE, and this is the finding worth carrying: the family's standing VIX statistic is not a property of minutes days. Across the 157 releases 2007-2026 that lane re-parsed from the Board's own pages, VIX closes lower on 64.3% -- but both events are Wednesdays, so 50 of the 157 collide, and split on that the share is 71.0% on the 107 non-collision releases against exactly 50.0% on the 50 collisions, a 21.0pp gap at two-sided permutation p = 0.0122 (50k shuffles). The collision half sits on the 54.4% universe base rate: no effect at all. HONEST LIMITS ON THAT NUMBER, because it will be quoted: the split was not pre-registered -- it was handed to the lane by this very file while sourcing this proposal -- and the historical classification is by the 88.9%-accurate rule above, which dilutes toward the null rather than inflating; residualised on the same session's index move the gap shrinks from -0.42 to -0.09 vs -0.19 mean VIX points, so it is a mechanism for part of a raw number, NOT a new edge, and it resurrects nothing the fomc-minutes-2027-10-06 lane's placebo control already killed. WHAT NOT TO CONCLUDE: no play is licensed on either side. symbols is empty, no house playbook (S1/S2/E1/S3/S4 + G1) is vol-keyed, and a settlement print is a mechanical event, not a signal. TWO NOTES FOR WHOEVER TAKES THIS ID. (1) The date does NOT inherit the FOMC's tentative-meeting chain -- it is fixed by the OCC's own published calendar and by SPX's December third Friday, neither of which depends on a Committee decision, so this entry can promote to OCC:/confirmed on a second venue (Cboe's settlement surface, the route vix-expiration-2027-01-20 took) long before the minutes date can. (2) opex-2027-11-19 is proposed in the same PR from the same file's adjacent rows; the two are the standard Wed/Fri pair, not a duplicate. Proposed as an estimate; estimate widens caution and licenses no entry.
